statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116328 (PostgreSQL generation memory context integer wraparound executes arbitrary code): freeing an allocation larger than 1 GB in a generation memory context lets its block be reused for smaller chunks whose back-pointer offset cannot represent that position, letting a database user run code as the operating system user running the server; the PostgreSQL record lists 16 to 18 as affected. It is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16 for the 16 major version. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116328/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/735b0dc1a73727956e876f8abaaeaaef588416cc, which changes src/backend/utils/mmgr/generation.c, carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116328" and is in the REL_16_16 tag. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116328 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the files the fix touches. This owner covers the packages built from Alpine's postgresql16 recipe: postgresql16 and its subpackages postgresql16-client, -contrib, -contrib-jit, -dev, -doc, -jit, -openrc, -plperl, -plperl-contrib, -plpython3, -plpython3-contrib and -pltcl. We checked every package built from that source in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 4 builds (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, each against its index checksum; 16.14-r0 for x86_64 is published without the -plperl-contrib, -plpython3, -plpython3-contrib and -pltcl subpackages. The server binary /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres in each build reports its release on both architectures: PostgreSQL 16.13 in 16.13-r0, PostgreSQL 16.14 in 16.14-r0, PostgreSQL 16.15 in 16.15-r0 and PostgreSQL 16.16 in 16.16-r0. The builds before 16.16-r0 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) are PostgreSQL releases before 16.16 and are affected; 16.16-r0 carries the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116328 (integer wraparound in generation memory contexts lets a database user execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the server; the PostgreSQL record lists 16 to 18 as affected) in 17.12 on the 17 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116328/. Checked every published build of this owner on amd64 and arm64: the server binary in 17.12-0 and in the build of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12, which contains the fix; the earlier builds, 17.11-1 and the build of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1, report PostgreSQL 17.11 and are affected.
